title: The Quiet Warehouse Fire
overview: A small fire broke out in a storage warehouse after hours. No one was hurt, but the cause is unclear.
objective: Determine what most likely caused the fire.

hypotheses.statement: A faulty space heater left running overnight started the fire.
The fire was started deliberately by a disgruntled employee.

evidence.title: Fire department summary
evidence.content: Fire originated near the east storage racks. No accelerant odor noted. Investigation ongoing.

evidence.title: Warehouse floor plan
evidence.content: East racks are used for overflow stock; a small break area with a space heater sits nearby.

evidence.title: Maintenance log
evidence.content: The space heater in the east break area was flagged for a frayed cord three weeks ago; the work order was never closed.

evidence.title: Extra: security guard's note (contextual hint)
evidence.content: Hint: the night guard's log mentions the break-area heater was still glowing red when he did his 11 PM round.

evidence.title: Extra: badge log around the fire (twist)
evidence.content: Twist: no employee badges were used to enter the warehouse after 9 PM, hours before the fire started.
